basic.name: Magic Missiles
basic.description: Fire three missiles toward an area, each dealing 147~~0.035~~ damage to the first enemy hit. These missiles do 50% damage to Structures.

basic.name: Arcane Orb
basic.description: Fire an Orb that powers up as it travels, dealing 135~~0.03~~ damage to the first enemy hit. Damage is increased the further it travels, up to 270~~0.03~~ more damage.

heroic.name: Disintegrate
heroic.description: Channel a powerful beam, dealing 480~~0.05~~ damage over 2.6 seconds to enemies while they are in it. The direction of the beam changes with your mouse cursor position.

heroic.name: Wave of Force
heroic.description: Knock away all enemies from an area and deal 160~~0.05~~ damage.

heroic.name: Disintegrate
heroic.description: Channel a powerful beam, dealing 192~~0.05~~ damage per second to enemies while they are in it. The direction of the beam changes with your mouse cursor position.

trait.name: Critical Mass
trait.description: Getting a Takedown will refresh the cooldown on all of Li-Ming's Abilities.

activable.name: Illusionist
activable.description:
If Li-Ming loses more than 20% of her Health at once, its cooldown is instantly refreshed. 

This effect has a 4 second cooldown.

Passive: Increases Teleport range by 50%

activable.name: Archon: Pure Power
activable.description: Activate to enter Archon form, allowing Li-Ming to repeatedly use Disintegrate, but be unable to cast other Abilities.

level1.name: Force Armor
level1.description:
When Magic Missiles damages an enemy Hero, gain 50 Spell Armor, reducing the damage taken by the next Ability by 50%. Gain 1 charge per cast and store up to 4 charges.

Passive: Li-Ming's Mana regeneration is increased by 100% while below 35% Mana.

level1.name: Aether Walker
level1.description: Teleport costs no Mana. If Li-Ming hasn't taken damage in the last 3 seconds, Teleport's cooldown is decreased by 2 seconds. Casting Teleport causes Li-Ming's next cast of Magic Missiles to deal 10% bonus damage.

level1.name: Power Hungry
level1.description: Regeneration Globes restore 100% more Mana and grant 10% Spell Power for 20 seconds.

level4.name: Charged Blast
level4.description: Basic Attacking a target recently hit by a Magic Missile does an extra 87~~0.04~~ damage.

level4.name: Triumvirate
level4.description: If Arcane Orb hits an enemy Hero after traveling at least 50% of its base range, the cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds and 40 Mana is refunded.

level4.name: Dominance
level4.description: Takedowns restore 30% of Li-Ming's missing Health.

level7.name: Seeker
level7.description: If three Magic Missiles hit the same target, the third one deals an additional 140~~0.04~~ damage.

level7.name: Zei's Vengeance
level7.description: Increase Arcane Orb's damage increase for distance traveled by 30%. Additionally, reduce its cooldown by 1 second.

level7.name: Calamity
level7.description: Teleport does 300~~0.03~~ damage to enemy Heroes near the destination.

level10.name: Disintegrate
level10.description: Channel a powerful beam, dealing 480~~0.05~~ damage over 2.6 seconds to enemies while they are in it. The direction of the beam changes with your mouse cursor position.

level10.name: Wave of Force
level10.description: Knock away all enemies from an area and deal 160~~0.05~~ damage.

level13.name: Illusionist
level13.description:
If Li-Ming loses more than 20% of her Health at once, its cooldown is instantly refreshed. 

This effect has a 4 second cooldown.

Passive: Increases Teleport range by 50%

level13.name: Cannoneer
level13.description: When Li-Ming uses an Ability, her next Basic Attack's damage is increased by 75% and deals Spell damage instead of Physical. Stacks up to 3 times.

level13.name: Glass Cannon
level13.description: Increase Li-Ming's Spell Power by 20%, but decrease her maximum Health by 15%.

level16.name: Fireflies
level16.description: Drastically increases Magic Missiles speed. Its cooldown is reduced by 1 second, and its Mana cost is reduced by 5.

level16.name: Mirrorball
level16.description: Magic Missiles fires an additional 2 missiles, but its Mana cost is increased by 5.

level16.name: Arcane Orbit
level16.description: Arcane Orb travels 25% farther, increasing its maximum distance damage bonus from 270~~0.03~~ to 371~~0.03~~.

level16.name: Diamond Skin
level16.description: Teleport grants a Shield equal to 25% of Li-Ming's maximum Health for 4 seconds.

level20.name: Temporal Flux
level20.description: Disintegrate gradually Slows enemies caught in its beam, to a maximum of 60%.

level20.name: Repulsion
level20.description: Increases Wave of Force knockback distance by 175% and increases its cast range by 95%.

level20.name: Tal Rasha's Elements
level20.description: Casting Abilities increases the damage of the next Ability by 5%, up to 20%. This bonus is reset when the same Ability is used within a chain.

level20.name: Archon: Pure Power
level20.description: Activate to enter Archon form, allowing Li-Ming to repeatedly use Disintegrate, but be unable to cast other Abilities.
